identity.description: An attacker executes a PowerShell command with high entropy to obfuscate malicious code, triggering the 'Globally uncommon high entropy process was executed' alert. Cortex should detect the process start and analyze entropy metrics.

expected_artifacts.description: Execution of a high entropy process

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: High Entropy Process Start
biocs.description: Detects execution of a process with high entropy indicative of obfuscation
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_entropy > 7.5

abiocs.name: Uncommon High Entropy Process Execution
abiocs.description: Detects execution of a process with entropy significantly higher than typical benign processes
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_entropy > 7.2

xql_queries.name: High Entropy Process Hunt
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_entropy > 7.0
| fields action_process_image_name, action_process_entropy, agent_hostname
